backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor definition with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing branding-related feature specs, affected files, and associated components/tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing various frontend source files and their roles in the application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables and light/dark mode CSS custom properties.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry file setting metadata and linking the generated favicon and React entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component handling routing, global state, theme initialization, and layout rendering.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Utilities for exporting and importing JSON backups with file reading, validation, and migration.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Backup data schema, validation logic, and migration merging settings with defaults.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated SVG circular progress component displaying percentage with color states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Card showing subject info, attendance stats, and optional premium insights with a progress indicator.
Layout wrapper providing consistent page structure, theme-aware background, and spacing for bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Builds a bottom sheet that loads today's timetable slots, lets users set attendance status per class, and saves the resulting ClassEvent entries.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a mobile-friendly bottom navigation bar with active state styling and tab-switch callbacks.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Displays branding, version info, and founder details, adapting the logo to the current theme.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Provides backup export/import controls with file selection, confirmation dialog, and restore callbacks.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings, permission requests, and a test notification with success/error feedback.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Allows adjusting the attendance target using a slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Lets users choose light/dark/system theme and select a color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable title, description, and action label.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu offering edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog component for adding or editing subjects with validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that displays a fallback UI and allows reloading the app.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Animated splash screen showing the app logo and loading indicators during initialization.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Displays non-blocking error toasts when an error object is provided.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Utility functions for computing attendance stats, insights, streaks, and safe bunk calculations.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer managing subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, and full state resets.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Core TypeScript types and default state for subjects, events, settings, and attendance data.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Functions for predicting attendance trends and generating motivational streak messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup plus light, dark, and midnight theme CSS variables with global resets and reduced‑motion support.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Provides branding constants and functions returning theme‑agnostic logo asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility helpers for class merging, ID generation, date formatting, weekday lookup, and subject color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry mounting React root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Builds notification titles and bodies for class marking actions, including multi‑status summaries.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wrapper around browser Notifications API handling support checks, permission flow, and sending notifications.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard page showing overall stats, subject cards, marking classes, and sending notifications after updates.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page managing theme, targets, notifications, premium features, and backup/restore controls.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Subject detail page displaying attendance stats, safe bunk and target calculations, and edit/reset/delete actions.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Renders an editable weekly timetable grid allowing subjects to be assigned to day/period slots using global state.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Provides global app state via React Context with reducer-based updates, plus IndexedDB-backed load/save effects.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Wraps IndexedDB load/save with state validation and merges loaded settings with defaults.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Implements low-level IndexedDB operations for saving, loading, and clearing the app state.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies light/dark mode and theme variants, and optionally listens for system theme changes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, radii, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, requirements, branding notes, issues, and image asset specifications for BunkPro.
